title: Staff Platform Engineer
description: Meet DeepL DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation. Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures. Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination. What sets us apart What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected. When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture. What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog . Meet the team behind this journey You will join the Hybrid Platform Engineering track, which builds and operates the compute layer underpinning DeepL's products and research: the Kubernetes control plane, node lifecycle, networking, storage and core cluster services, across both on-prem and cloud infrastructure. Today that spans hybrid infrastructure in Europe - including large on-prem GPU clusters powering DeepL's research and hundreds of on-prem GPU nodes serving production inference - as well as AWS regions across the globe running the product. The track is deepening this hybrid model, unifying how workloads run across on-prem hardware and AWS to give product and research teams a self-service foundation they can build on. Your responsibilities Take ownership of the reliability, capacity and cost efficiency of DeepL's compute infrastructure, CPU and GPU: the hybrid platform serving our products across AWS and on-prem, and the on-prem clusters powering our research, including their hardware lifecycle Shape the platform's architecture: bring strong technical positions, weigh them on their merits with your peers, and commit to decisions serving the best outcome Design, build and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters across cloud and on-prem infrastructure, taking them from design through to long-term operation Drive the technical work of deepening the hybrid model - unifying how workloads run across on-prem hardware and cloud, especially AWS and supporting research as it adopts cloud-native technology and ways of working Define infrastructure-as-code and platform standards that hold across the track, and strengthen observability and security so the platform's behaviour is legible to the teams that depend on it Mentor engineers across the infrastructure track and raise the technical bar of the group, through design reviews, architecture decisions and the everyday habits that keep the platform maintainable Build consensus across engineering teams and turn it into shipped change, shaping platform direction at track level Lead incident response for hybrid infrastructure, driving remediation through to root cause, and help sustain an on-call rotation the team can carry for the long term What you bring to the table Deep, hands-on Kubernetes expertise: you have designed, built and operated clusters at scale, through their full lifecycle Depth at scale in either public cloud or on-prem infrastructure, plus the credibility to work in the other. AWS experience is preferred, and bare-metal or data centre experience is strongly valued Networking and Linux depth you can debug with: you can follow a problem from a container through the host to the network edge Infrastructure as code with Terraform or equivalent, and GitOps delivery with tooling such as ArgoCD, applied to environments you have owned in production Software engineering skills in at least one major language, Go or Python preferred, at the level of building tooling other engineers rely on A track record of technical ownership spanning several teams: you create clarity where a mandate crosses team boundaries, hold clear technical positions, change them on evidence and carry other engineers with you Strong incident-management and reliability-engineering discipline, and the ownership mindset to build more resilient systems You’d get bonus points for GPU infrastructure for training or inference at scale Distributed storage systems in production, such as Ceph Having served researchers or data scientists as platform customers Networking at BGP level in a hybrid or on-prem environment What we offer: Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network. Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together. Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team's general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration. Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future. title: Product Manager, Interactive Avatars (Staff/Principal-level)
description: Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations. Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow. About the role For years, avatars have been something you watch. You write a script, we render a video, someone presses play. That model has taken AI video a long way but it has a ceiling. A video can't answer a question. It can't read the room. It can't role-play a tough conversation and adapt when you push back. We're changing that. Interactive Avatars listen, talk, and respond in real time; inside your product, your website, or your internal tools. You bring the logic and the language model; we power the avatar layer: the speech, the expression, the listening, the sense that there's someone actually there. It's early. Interactive Avatars is in closed beta today, and the teams building on it are pushing it into places we didn't expect - AI sales reps, always-on support agents, interactive trainers, onboarding guides. We're hiring a Product Manager to own it and take it from beta to a platform that thousands of developers build on. This is a role with real scope. You'll help define what a real-time avatar API should be, the surface developers integrate against, the experience end users feel, and the commercial model that makes it a business. You'll work directly with the engineering and research teams building the real-time avatar stack, and with the design partners already live in the beta. The problem you're solving Today, a developer who wants a lifelike, real-time avatar in their product has to stitch together a streaming pipeline, a rendering layer, an agent, and a set of hard real-time problems - latency, interruption handling, listening behavior, expressiveness, consistency across sessions, most of which have nothing to do with the product they're actually trying to build. We have the avatar technology and a working beta. What we need is a PM who can turn that into an API a developer can integrate in an afternoon, trust in production, and build a real business on top of, all while holding a quality bar high enough that the experience feels human, not uncanny. What you'll be doing Owning the end-to-end Interactive Avatar API. This is the developer-facing surface (SDK, integration patterns, docs), the real-time experience quality, and the path from closed beta to general availability, and defining what the roadmap looks like over the coming cycles Getting close to the developers and teams building on the beta: understanding how they integrate, where the API fights them, which real-time behaviors make or break the experience, and what "production-ready" means to them Translating that understanding into a clear product direction. What to build, in what order, and why, and keeping the team aligned as the strategy evolves Working closely with the engineering and research teams building the real-time avatar stack; contributing clear specs, sound judgment on trade-offs (quality vs. latency vs. cost), and the context that helps them build the right thing the first time Partnering with go-to-market and commercial teams to define how the API is packaged, priced, and sold - a real-time API has a fundamentally different business model from batch video, and shaping that is part of the job Defining and tracking the metrics that tell us whether the product is working across adoption, integration success, real-time quality, reliability, and the commercial signals that prove it's a business Who you are You've owned a developer-facing product before like an API, an SDK, or a platform and you know that the product is the developer experience. You understand that adoption is won or lost in the first hour of integration, and that trust is won or lost the first time something breaks in production. You build accordingly. You're comfortable in a space where the roadmap isn't fully formed. You don't need a clean brief to get started. You can talk to developers, watch them integrate, synthesize what you see, and come back with a point of view. You're also honest about what you don't know and willing to update when the evidence changes. You care about the detail, and you can hold a quality bar for something subjective and hard: a real-time avatar either feels present and responsive or it feels off, and the difference lives in latency, interruption handling, expressiveness, and consistency. You know how to make that bar concrete and defend it. You think commercially. A new API isn't just a technical surface. It's a business, and you have instincts (or scar tissue) around how developer products get adopted, packaged, and monetized. Requirements: 5+ years in product, with direct experience owning a developer-facing API, SDK, or platform product. The vertical doesn't matter, the platform depth does Comfortable operating in an early-stage, 0→1 environment where discovery and delivery happen in parallel and the roadmap is still being shaped Strong technical fluency: you can hold a credible conversation with engineers about real-time systems, latency, and integration trade-offs, and make good calls without needing every answer handed to you Strong written communication: you can write a spec, a strategy doc, or an API design rationale that others can act on without a follow-up conversation Real-time / streaming media, conversational AI, or applied-AI product experience is a strong plus but not a prerequisite. Instinct for the commercial side of a developer product - adoption, packaging, and monetization is a plus. Based in London or open to regular in-person time. Our culture At Synthesia we’re passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here. Location Flexible, hybrid role based from our London office. Global benefits: You will be compensated well with a generous salary and equity. You get 25 days of annual leave + local holidays. Regular team offsites where you’ll get to collaborate with the product & engineering team in person. Work from home budget Work from anywhere policy of 60 days per year Generous referral scheme Enhanced parental leave - maternity leave includes 16 weeks at full pay, and paternity leave includes 5 weeks at full pay (if your country’s government scheme offers more generous support, you receive whichever is greater—our enhanced policy or the local statutory benefit) Benefits specific to UK: Private healthcare via AXA for you with a discount for dependants 5% pension match Team lunches Tuesday-Friday in the office Flexible, hybrid role based from our London office. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><p>Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.</p> <p>Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.</p> <p>We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Be Doing</strong></p> <p>You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.</p> <p>Here's what your day-to-day might look like:</p> <ul> <li>Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.</li> <li>Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.</li> <li>Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.</li> <li>Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You'll Need to Thrive</strong></p> <p>Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:</p> <ul> <li>Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.</li> <li>You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.</li> <li>You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.</li> <li>You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.</li> <li>You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.</li> <li>You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.</li> <li>You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).</li> <li>You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.</li> </ul> <h2>Next steps</h2> <p>The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/Ncz4s_oBczc?si=FzuwoSOLcv5WZVRN" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Diversity, Equity and Inclusion</strong><br><br>At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. title: Engineering Manager – Server-Driven UI (Codeless)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><h2>About the role</h2> <p>We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Codeless, our internal Server-Driven UI (SDUI) platform team. In this role, you will lead a cross-functional team bridging mobile/web frontend engineering and core platform backend systems.</p> <p>While this role is deeply rooted in modern UI architecture, its mission goes beyond standard UI development: Codeless empowers product teams across the organization to ship dynamic, native UI experiences dynamically from the backend—eliminating app store release bottlenecks, dramatically accelerating feature iteration, and establishing a unified UI schema across iOS, Android, and Web.</p> <h2>What you’ll be doing</h2> <p>This is a role with broad impact, from hands-on technical guidance to championing web and mobile accessibility across the company. We're looking for a leader who excels at fostering collaboration and can confidently guide a concept from initial idea to robust implementation.</p> <h3><strong>Day-to-day in this role you’ll:</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Team Leadership & Strategy: </strong>Build, mentor, and scale an engineering team responsible for our core Server-Driven UI platform ("Codeless"). Foster an inclusive, high-ownership engineering culture.</li> <li><strong>Platform Architecture & Evolution:</strong> Oversee the design and evolution of dynamic layout engines, declarative UI schemas, and client rendering frameworks across iOS, Android, and Web.</li> <li><strong>Developer Velocity & Platform Adoption:</strong> Partner with product feature teams to drive internal adoption of Codeless. Ensure the platform provides exceptional Developer Experience, clear tooling, robust design system integration, and seamless debugging workflows.</li> <li><strong>Technical Execution & Quality:</strong> Set high technical standards for platform performance, payload optimization, caching strategies, backward compatibility, and graceful offline/fallback behavior across client devices.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration:</strong> Work closely with Product Managers, Design System leaders, and Core Infrastructure engineers to align the Codeless roadmap with broader company initiatives and global design paradigms.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll need to thrive</h2> <p><strong>Engineering Management:</strong> 3+ years of experience managing software engineering teams, with a track record of coaching engineers, delivering complex platform initiatives, and driving technical strategy.</p> <p><strong>UI & Platform Domain Expertise:</strong> Strong foundational background in mobile (iOS/Android) or modern web architecture (React, SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose, or declarative UI paradigms).</p> <p><strong>Product & Platform Mindset: </strong>Ability to treat internal product engineering teams as customers, evaluating platform success through developer velocity, adoption metrics, and rendering performance.</p> <h2>Why join us</h2> <p>At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Check out our Tech Blog.</p> <p>We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. We are looking for curious, proactive individuals who are passionate about practical, real-world AI adoption. You won't just talk about AI transformation in the abstract; you will help clients explore how AI can be applied to real operational challenges, support the development of AI-enabled services and processes, and contribute to meaningful change across the public sector. Working alongside experienced colleagues and client teams, you will help bridge the gap between what AI can do and what can be successfully implemented in complex public sector environments. Through analysis, stakeholder engagement, workshops and practical demonstrations, you will help make AI transformation tangible, accessible and valuable for our clients.</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span></span></h3> <p> </p> <ul> <li><strong>Process Reimagination: </strong>Support clients in exploring how services, processes <li><strong>Demo-Led Engagement: </strong>Use hands-on demonstrations, workshops and practical examples to help stakeholders understand AI capabilities and limitations, building confidence through tangible proof points rather than theory.</li> <li><strong>Research & Insight Development: </strong>Maintain awareness of developments across GenAI tools, AI-enabled services and public sector adoption trends, translating emerging capabilities into practical insights for clients and engagement teams.</li> <li><strong>Client Delivery: </strong>Take ownership of high-quality deliverables trusted relationships with clients, colleagues and third parties, supporting workshops, interviews and working sessions that help shape AI-enabled change.</li> <li><strong>Best Practice Development: </strong>Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of Baringa's AI methodologies, playbooks, frameworks and reusable assets, helping strengthen our Government AI capability.</li> <li><strong>Business Development Support: </strong>Contribute to proposals, thought leadership, credential development and client opportunities, helping identify where AI capabilities can create additional value for clients.</li> <li><strong>Team Contribution:</strong> Actively participate in Baringa's internal AI initiatives, sharing knowledge and supporting capability development across the wider Government practice.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"> </span><br><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and data or technology-enabled change.</li> <li>Understanding of how government organisations operate, including the practical constraints associated with governance, information security, data privacy and operational delivery.</li> <li>Strong interest in AI adoption and practical experience using leading AI ecosystems such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude or equivalent tools within day-to-day work.</li> <li>Experience supporting organisations in the adoption of new technologies, digital tools, operating model changes or transformation initiatives.</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex issues and develop practical recommendations.</li> <li>Experience creating high-quality client-facing deliverables, presentations, reports and workshop materials.</li> <li>Ability to build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams.</li> <li>A proactive approach to learning, with curiosity about emerging AI developments and their practical application in public sector settings.</li> <li>Commitment to the responsible use of AI, with an appreciation of governance, risk and ethical considerations associated with AI adoption.</li> <li>A pragmatic mindset that focuses on creating measurable value and tangible outcomes rather than pursuing technology for its own sake.</li> </ul> <p>All roles will require a level of security clearance; BPSS OR Security Clearance OR Developed Vetting.</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What a career title: Senior Director, Commercial Lead
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><p><strong>ABOUT THE TEAM</strong><br>The UK Growth team owns how Anduril builds and converts opportunity in the UK, from market engagement and capture through to contract. We draw on business lines, legal, finance, engineering, programme management expertise from across Anduril to turn capability into contracts. There is no dedicated commercial function in the UK today. This role is the first of its kind, sitting within Growth, and the person in this seat will shape Anduril UK’s commercial approach.<br><br><strong>ABOUT THE JOB</strong><br>We are looking for a Commercial Officer to join our rapidly growing team in London. You will own and drive the commercial strategy for Anduril's UK defence business, operating at the intersection of strategy, business development, and deal execution. You will help build and manage a pipeline of government and defence contracts, structure and negotiate deals, and make sure Anduril captures and delivers on opportunities across the MOD.<br><br>This role demands breadth. You will engage at senior levels with military leaders, government officials, and industry partners, and you will also roll up your sleeves on contract negotiation, pricing, and bid strategy. Anduril's UK presence is scaling fast and established playbooks for all scenarios do not yet exist, so you must be comfortable with ambiguity and willing to build process where none exists.<br><br><strong>WHAT YOU'LL DO</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and execute Anduril's commercial strategy for the UK defence market, aligned with the company's growth objectives.</li> <li>Work with the wider Business Development team to win opportunities across UK government procurement programmes, direct contracts, and partnership-led bids.</li> <li>Develop pricing and margin strategy in coordination with business lines and Global Defence, balancing competitiveness with business sustainability.</li> <li>Lead deal structuring, negotiation, and close on major defence contracts, including government-to-government, prime-sub, and teaming arrangements.</li> <li>Own the commercial terms of bids and proposals, ensuring alignment with MOD procurement frameworks (e.g. DEFCON, SSRO regulations).</li> <li>Manage commercial risk across the portfolio, including export control compliance (ITAR/EAR), offset/industrial participation obligations, and sovereign requirements.</li> <li>Serve as the primary commercial interface with MOD Commercial and Defence Procurement</li> <li>Build and sustain relationships at senior levels across UK MOD, the NADG, and Front Line Commands.</li> <li>Represent Anduril at industry events, defence exhibitions, and government engagements as a credible commercial voice.</li> <li>Work closely with Anduril's US-based commercial and legal teams to align UK deal structures with corporate standards.</li> <li>Build the UK commercial function from the ground up – hiring, process, negotiating, deal structuring</li> <li>Establish commercial governance frameworks appropriate for a scaling defence business, including approval authorities, contract review processes, and pipeline reporting.</li> <li>Act as player-coach: personally leading on marquee pursuits, and, when scale dictates, mobilise and develop a team to handle the growing pipeline.</li> <li>Navigate ambiguity and define your own path – the UK operation is scaling rapidly, and established playbooks may not exist yet.</li> </ul> <p><strong>REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of progressive commercial experience in UK defence, with a track record of winning and delivering government contracts.</li> <li>Deep understanding of UK MOD procurement, including DEFCON terms, Single Source regulations, and National Armaments Director Group acquisition processes.</li> <li>Proven ability to structure and negotiate complex defence deals, including teaming agreements, subcontracts, and government primes.</li> <li>Experience managing export control and technology transfer requirements, including ITAR, EAR, and UK OGEL/SIEL frameworks.</li> <li>Credible engaging at SCS2 level and above with senior military and government stakeholders.</li> <li>Strong commercial judgement, able to balance risk, margin, and strategic value in deal decisions.</li> <li>Comfort working across a diverse range of disciplines including design, engineering, programme management, legal and contracts, supply chain, and finance.</li> <li>Ability to be local to or relocate to London, UK.</li> <li>SC cleared and eligible to obtain and maintain DV clearance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in autonomous systems or advanced defence technology programmes.</li> <li>Familiarity with US defence contracting norms and FMS/DCS frameworks, enabling effective coordination with Anduril's US headquarters.</li> <li>Experience building a commercial function in a high-growth or start-up environment.</li> <li>Background in or exposure to industrial participation, offset, SSRO, innovative commercial deal structuring and sovereign capability development programmes.</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">UK Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$166,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$220,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span data-contrast="auto">The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. title: Senior People Business Partner
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Mixpanel</strong></p> <p>Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at <a href="https://mixpanel.com/home/">mixpanel.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>About the People and Culture Team</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p>The Mixpanel People team exists to help every employee do their best work. We build the structure and support that enables a high-performing organization to move fast without losing what makes us Mixpanel - connection, candor, and the values we hold each other to.</p> <p>A core driver of Mixpanel's success is investing in our people and clearing the way for individuals and teams of every background to reach their full potential. The People function leads that work - executing our people strategy, advising senior leadership, and running HR operations with the rigor a high-performing company demands.</p> <p>Within that team, this role owns the EMEA go-to-market population specifically — three offices (London, Barcelona, and Tel Aviv) growing fast enough that the programs supporting them are still being built, not just maintained.</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p>This is a hybrid role based in London, supporting Mixpanel's EMEA business across our London, Barcelona, and Israel offices, embedded with our Go-To-Market leadership team. You'll report to our Global Head of HR Business Partners and operate as a strategic, trusted advisor to EMEA GTM leadership - shaping programs and policy, not just executing them.</p> <p>This is a multi-country role by design. Your GTM population sits across the UK, Spain, and Israel, so working knowledge of employment law and practice in all three is essential - the right call in one market is often the wrong call in another. Experience supporting teams in APAC is a strong plus as our footprint there grows, but it isn't required.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary People Business Partner for Mixpanel's EMEA GTM leadership team, operating as a strategic, trusted advisor on org design, workforce planning, and talent strategy.</li> <li>Proactively coach and partner with GTM people managers and leaders across EMEA to build, lead, and grow high-performing teams.</li> <li>Lead complex, multi-country change initiatives — reorgs, comp cycles, policy rollouts — from strategy through communication, partnering with stakeholders to build buy-in rather than just announcing outcomes.</li> <li>Investigate and resolve employee relations matters across the UK, Spain, and Israel, balancing legal risk, company principle, and individual dignity.</li> <li>Turn workforce data — attrition, engagement, performance — into a business case leaders act on, not just a report they skim.</li> <li>Collaborate with the broader People team on programs that elevate the employee experience company-wide, bringing an EMEA- and GTM-specific point of view to global design.</li> <li>Maintain fluency in HR principles, practices, and regulatory environments across the UK, Spain, and Israel to recommend policy with confidence.</li> <li>Build automation and AI into your own workflows and the team's — using it to move faster on the transactional work so there's more time for the judgment calls that need a person.</li> </ul> <p><strong>We're Looking For Someone Who Has</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in HR/People roles, including 5+ years as a dedicated People/HR Business Partner, ideally supporting Sales or go-to-market organizations.</li> <li>Working knowledge of employment law and HR practice in the UK, Spain, & Israel — experience in all 3 regions preferred but required in UK & Spain.</li> <li>Deep functional experience in two or more HR areas: talent management, employee relations, employee experience, compensation, organizational development, or HR policy.</li> <li>A track record of leading through ambiguity and owning multi-country problems end to end.</li> <li>Strong analytical and project management skills, with sound commercial judgment and empathy in equal measure.</li> <li>Fluency with AI and automation tools, and a habit of using them to create efficiency in your own work rather than waiting for someone else to build the solution.</li> <li>Excellent, direct communication — the kind that earns trust even in hard conversations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points For</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience supporting APAC teams or navigating employment practice in other European markets.</li> </ul> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Benefits and Perks</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care</li> <li>Mental Wellness Benefit</li> <li>Generous Vacation Policy & Additional Company Holidays</li> <li>Enhanced Parental Leave</li> <li>Volunteer Time Off</li> <li>Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break</li> </ul> <p><em>*please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary*</em></p> <p><strong>Culture Values</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Make Bold Bets:</strong> We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.</li> <li><strong>Innovate with Insight:</strong> We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes.</li> <li><strong>One Team:</strong> We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.</li> <li><strong>Candor with Connection:</strong> We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.</li> <li><strong>Champion the Customer:</strong> We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.</li> <li><strong>Powerful Simplicity:</strong> We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why choose Mixpanel?</strong></p> <p>We’re a leader in analytics with over 29,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Mixpanel is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. At Mixpanel, we are focused on things that really matter—our people, our customers, our partners—out of a recognition that those relationships are the most valuable assets we have. We actively encourage women, people with disabilities, veterans, underrepresented minorities, and LGBTQ+ people to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance or other similar laws that may be applicable, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We’ve immersed ourselves in our Culture and Values as our guiding principles for the impact we want to have and the future we are building.</span></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About the AI Security Institute</h2> <p>The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally.</p> <p>We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action.</p></div><h2><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">Team Description </span></span></strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2"> </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134245418":true,"134245529":true,"335557856":16777215,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></h2> <p><span data-contrast="none">Risks from misaligned AI systems are growing increasingly important as AI systems become more capable, autonomous, and integrated into society. title: Senior Risk & Assurance Manager EU/UK
description: WHO WE ARE At Trustly, we're building a smarter, faster, and more secure financial future by revolutionizing the world of payments. As a global leader in Open Banking Payments, we are establishing Pay by Bank as the new standard at checkout, providing unparalleled freedom, speed, and ease to millions of consumers and merchants worldwide. Our Ambition: To build the world’s most disruptive payment network and redefine what the payment experience should feel like. Trustly is a global team of innovators, collaborators, and doers. If you are driven by a strong sense of purpose and thrive in a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and high-growth environment, join us and be part of a team that’s transforming the way the world pays. ABOUT THE ROLE We are building a dedicated Risk and Compliance Assurance function in the Second Line of Defence, and we are seeking a Senior Risk and Assurance Manager to own a single view of the second-line risk and control environment across Trustly's EU and UK regulated entities. As the Senior Risk and Assurance Manager, you will lead entity-level assurance and second-line risk oversight for Trustly’s EU and UK regulated entities, supported by the Global Enterprise Risk Management framework. This role will be part of a wider community of risk and assurance managers, which will also cover specific compliance domains (such as Financial Crimes Prevention, Safeguarding, Consumer Protection, ICT and Resilience). The focus of this role is the regulated entities in the UK and EU. You will confirm that domain testing reflects local requirements and local regulator expectations, and report findings to the entity Boards. You will serve as the primary point of contact for UK and EU regulators on risk and assurance matters. This role is suited to a seasoned assurance, compliance, and/or second-line risk professional with experience in regulated financial/payment institutions, ideally with experience of engaging with regulators. What you'll do Manage assurance at an entity level for Trustly’s EU and UK regulated entities, and be responsible for risk in these entities. Own a single view of the second-line control and risk environment across Trustly's EU and UK regulated entities, and contribute to standardised reporting including Key Risk Indicators and unified tracking. Confirm the local regulatory applicability of domain testing scope and methodology. Own the assurance opinion, reporting of findings, and the risk view to each entity Board and local management team, and support what the entity Compliance lead attests to. Contribute to the annual assurance planning through active engagement in an assurance forum, jointly reviewing and signing off scope with the relevant domain assurance managers. Serve as a primary point of contact toward the relevant EU and UK regulators/supervisors on risk and assurance matters, representing the function confidently and credibly. Support Internal Audit's reliance assessment by maintaining a transparent, evidenced audit trail per test, and document any risk-accepted changes to testing cadence. WHO YOU ARE 5+ years experience as a compliance assurance and/or second-line risk manager Payments sector experience preferred Experience engaging with EU and/or UK financial supervisory authorities is desired A confident and articulate approach, demonstrating an ability to represent the risk and assurance function credibly and build productive relationships across business teams, and to advise and collaborate with stakeholders at various levels, including senior management and Board members. Sound understanding of the EU and UK regulatory landscape relevant to payment institutions Ability to lead end-to-end assurance reviews; planning, scoping, reporting and issue validation, including knowledge of control testing methodologies, sampling, issue rating, and evidence standards. A firm grasp of the three-lines model and the independence boundary between second and third line, with the judgement to keep assurance independent. High attention to detail in the preparation of control findings and management-level documentation. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex concepts and present to senior leadership, Boards, and regulators. Willingness to work flexibly to collaborate with team members across different time zones. WHAT WE OFFER At Trustly, you will have the chance to solve meaningful challenges alongside some of the brightest minds in FinTech. Together, we are shaping the future of payments in an environment that celebrates curiosity, collaboration, and innovation. You will be challenged and empowered to grow, making a real impact every step of the way. Our team is as diverse as the global footprint we serve. At Trustly, we foster a workplace where everyone feels they belong—a place where teamwork thrives, ideas flourish, and we never forget to have fun along the way. We are proud and committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer and believe an open and inclusive environment enables people to do their best work. Our Fantastic Benefits (varies by location) 🌴 20 to 30 days of holiday to support a healthy work-life balance 🥳 Monthly team outing allowance to enjoy social events with your colleagues 👶 Parental leave top-up additional support for new parents ☕ On-site perks to make your workday smoother 💚 Well being support our health allowance covers gym memberships, massages, and much more to help you feel your best PLUS additional benefits designed to enhance your work-life experience! Shape Your Role and Make an Impact Join a dynamic environment where you can take ownership, drive change, and continuously embrace new challenges. We’re looking for dedicated and highly motivated individuals who thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy collaborating across different areas of the organisation. title: Experience Operations
description: We pull medical technology from the future to solve human health. Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar. Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale. title: Product Manager
description: We pull medical technology from the future to solve human health. Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar. Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale. About the role As a Product Manager at Scarlet, you will own a meaningful product area end to end. You will develop a deep understanding of the people and problems within it, set a clear direction, decide what matters most, and work with product design and engineering to deliver measurable improvements. You will sit close to regulatory experts, account managers and customers in our London office. Their expertise will give you rich signals, but not a ready-made roadmap. Your job is to turn those signals into a coherent product strategy, make trade-offs openly and ensure what we build improves both the quality and speed of certification. You will have substantial autonomy. We will trust you to form a point of view, test it against evidence and change course when the evidence changes. Responsibilities Own the strategy, roadmap and outcomes for a product area, from discovery and definition through launch, adoption and iteration. Partner closely with product design, engineering and regulatory experts to turn complex requirements into clear, trustworthy workflows. Spend time with customers and internal users to understand their work, observe friction and distinguish underlying problems from requested features. Prioritise across customer value, regulatory rigour, operational efficiency, technical constraints and Scarlet’s company goals. Keep the team aligned on the problem, the intended outcome and the trade-offs behind each decision. Communicate product direction, decisions, progress and learning clearly across Scarlet. Help improve how Scarlet practises product management as the team grows. Required qualifications Evidence of owning and shipping complex products from discovery through delivery and iteration. Strong product judgement, including examples of difficult prioritisation choices made under real constraints. Enough technical fluency to work effectively with engineers on systems, data, APIs and the trade-offs of AI-enabled products. Clear, precise written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain complex decisions to different audiences. Comfort working in ambiguity, taking responsibility and updating your view when new evidence appears. High standards for product quality, reliability and trust. Preferred qualifications Experience in health technology, enterprise software, vertical SaaS or another regulated industry. Experience building products for complex, multi-stakeholder or expert-led workflows. Experience with AI-enabled products, including evaluation, failure modes and appropriate guardrails. Experience in an early-stage or fast-growing company where product practices were still being formed. Interview process We typically collapse steps 3 to 5 into one in-person session. Intro chat with Johnny - 30 minutes Engineering and design chats with Niclas and Jono - 30 minutes each Problem solving session with a member of tech ops - 30 minutes Interview with Johnny - 30 minutes Culture interviews with the founders Jamie and James - 30 minutes each References and offer. Application note You do not need to meet every preferred qualification to apply. We are interested in the quality of your judgement, the outcomes you have helped create and the way you learn. If this role excites you and your experience has taken a different route, we would still like to hear from you. title: Linux Desktop Support Engineer (London UK office)
description: <p>This is an opportunity to kickstart your career by joining Canonical. You will be working from our Canonical London Office and will be accountable for delivering technical support to our employees and customers, as well as facilitating AV support for office conferences and events. From problem qualification to full resolution, you will own and manage your cases. When needed, you will transfer your cases to your colleagues or involve senior engineers. If you have an affinity for open source development and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.</p> <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing.</p> <p>While our engineers regularly solve deeply interesting, complex technical problems - from triaging cloud environments to root-cause analysis on unseen Linux kernel crashes - this is fundamentally a role rooted in human connection. You will act as a trusted peer and technical guide to external engineering teams, translating intricate open-source challenges into clear, empathetic solutions. We are rapidly expanding and looking for brilliant problem solvers who are just as passionate about building strong, collaborative relationships with customers as they are about the next generation of Canonical solutions.</p> <p>Location: Office Based in London, England.</p> <h2><strong>The role entails</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Empathetic Engagement:</strong> Partner directly with customers across remote sessions, ticketing,, and live conversations to deeply understand and resolve their technical roadblocks.</li> <li><strong>Collaborative Problem Solving:</strong> Work hand-in-hand with internal engineering teams and regional peer groups to bridge the gap between complex code fixes and real-world customer satisfaction.</li> <li><strong>True Ownership:</strong> Manage your support cases with a strong sense of personal integrity, ensuring commitments are honored and customer expectations are communicated transparently and predictably.</li> <li><strong>Ubuntu Lifecycle Guidance:</strong> Develop a rich understanding of the Ubuntu development process, empowering you to give customers clear, human context regarding timelines for engineering fixes.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge Advocacy:</strong> Author and maintain accessible knowledge base articles, ensuring lessons learned are shared openly to elevate the entire open-source community.</li> <li><strong>Operational Reliability:</strong> Participate in a regular weekend working rotation to maintain seamless, high-touch continuity of care for our global partners.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What are we looking for in you</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Communication Excellence:</strong> Exceptional written and spoken English, with a natural ability to convey technical complexity clearly, warmly, and compellingly.</li> <li><strong>The Soft-Skill Edge:</strong> A genuine passion for helping people, paired with the emotional intelligence to navigate high-stakes technical situations with composure and empathy.</li> <li><strong>Academic Dedication:</strong> Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.</li> <li><strong>Educational Background:</strong> An undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.</li> <li><strong>On-Site Technical Leadership:</strong> Based in our state-of-the-art London, UK office, you will serve as a key technical support resource for our local teams and employees.</li> <li><strong>Driven Mindset:</strong> A proven track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to deliver meaningful, outstanding results for teams or customers.</li> <li><strong>Linux & Cloud Familiarity:</strong> Practical, hands-on experience supporting Linux systems, with an exposure to three or more of the following:</li> <ul> <li><em>Virtualization & Cloud:</em> Using KVM or OpenStack.</li> <li><em>Containers:</em> primarily Docker, LXD/LXC, or Kubernetes.</li> <li><em>Storage Ecosystems:</em> Block, object, and network storage technologies.</li> <li><em>System Networking:</em> Navigating bonding, firewalls, bridging, switching, or MTU tuning.</li> </ul> <li><strong>Analytical Curiosity:</strong> A strong troubleshooting mindset—the ability to look into stack traces or logs, identify OS/application-level bugs, and strategically guide the customer through next steps.</li> <li><strong>Development Fundamentals:</strong> Basic programming logic in any language to help parse code and collaborate effectively with Canonical Engineering teams.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h2> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

title: Senior Specialist, QA
description: <div class="content-intro"><p></p> <p><strong>About Summit:</strong></p> <p>Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.</p> <p>Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:</p> <p><strong>Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.</p> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.</p> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Colorectal Cancer (CRC)</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.</p> </li> </ul> <p><em>Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.</em></p> <p></p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Overview of Role:</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335557856":16777215,"335559739":240,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The Senior Specialist, QA will provide operational leadership and quality oversight for the review, approval and release-readiness of clinical and commercial product batches.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335551550":6,"335551620":6,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The role is responsible for ensuring that batch documentation is complete, accurate, traceable, and compliant with applicable GMP requirements, approved procedures and regulatory commitments before submission to QA for final disposition or QP certification. title: Lead Product Manager, Growth
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>📍London/Hybrid | 💰 Salary range £120,000 - £140,000 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits ✨</strong></p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What you’ll be working on </strong><strong>⭐</strong></p> <p>As a Lead Product Manager for Growth, you will define and deliver the future of how people first experience Monzo. This is a rare opportunity to lead one of Monzo’s most strategically critical product domains, owning high-complexity bets that shape how millions of people discover, join and trust our bank.</p> <p>You will own the strategic direction across our core growth engines: how we attract, onboard and activate people from their very first interaction. For our team, this means optimising the entire sign-up experience, removing activation friction, designing seamless new user journeys, and building powerful referral loops that turn everyday banking utility into organic network effects.</p> <p>You’ll set a compelling multi-cycle vision, craft multiple high-signal strategies, and create the experimentation engine that turns ambition into reality. We’re looking for someone who pairs an analyst's data rigour with world-class product craft, and possesses the conviction to make non-obvious bets without precedent.<br><br></p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...<br><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Leading the charge: set a durable product vision and strategy that spans multiple cycles, ensuring alignment with Monzo’s goals and an exceptional customer experience.</li> <li>Communicating effectively: you get people inspired by the product vision and you share the right context with the right people at the right time.</li> <li>Collaborating seamlessly: lead through influence across collectives, building deep partnerships with engineering, design, data, fincrime, legal and marketing to resolve complex organisational trade-offs.</li> <li>Delivering impact: define, deliver and measure the impact of the customer-focused experiences you create.</li> <li>Establishing high-velocity operating rhythms that empower squads to switch seamlessly between rapid experimentation, deep iteration and bold 0-1 builds.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You are a seasoned growth product manager, and have led multiple high-performing teams to ship world-class products at a fast growing company.</li> <li>You have a track record of leading high-scale consumer growth efforts that drive significant top of funnel value for customers and scaling for the business. </li> <li>You're exceptionally data-driven and commercial, and you know when to lean on rapid experimentation and when to move quicker with high conviction from first principles.</li> <li>You can systematically break down high-ambiguity product spaces that lack precedent, structuring clear narratives that cut through noise and align teams.</li> <li>You have excellent judgement, and have a track record of making good decisions in complex situations where there’s often no “right answer”. </li> <li>You hold an uncompromising standard for product craft, moving effortlessly between high level company strategy and deep execution.</li> <li>You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles - spanning engineering, design, data, user research, marketing, legal and compliance - to get stuff done.</li> <li>You’re a great storyteller, who is able to motivate, energise and inspire people towards a common goal.</li> <li>You have experience mentoring, coaching or managing other product managers, setting a high performance bar and multiplying your impact through the people around you.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £120,000 - £140,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK.</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor your visa. </p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><br><br></p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <p><br><strong>First stage - Recruiter screen<br></strong><strong>Second stage - Meet with our PM team<br></strong><strong>Third stage - Product full loop</strong></p> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>If you’d prefer to work part-time, please let us know and we'll make this happen if we can.</p> <p>Linkedin Tags: #LI-HR1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

SQL and Python are our desired coding languages but experience in SAS/R will be considered. A data visualisation tool (such as Streamlit or Looker) is a plus</li> <li>You can convey problems and solutions using clear and simple language, both written and verbal (see <a href="https://monzo.com/tone-of-voice/">Monzo’s tone of voice</a> guide). This is particularly important for communicating complex issues and priorities to non-experts</li> <li>You're impact driven and eager to have a real positive impact on the company, our products, our users and your team-mates</li> <li>You have a self-starter mindset<em>;</em> you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so</li> <li>You're a team player<em> </em>whom your colleagues can rely on</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>Initial call with a member of the Forecasting team</li> <li>Technical modelling interview </li> <li>Values and collaboration behavioural interview</li> <li>A live case study problem solving interview</li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £79,000 to £106,800 + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">benefits</a>  </p> <p>📍 London (one day a week)</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">here</a></p> <p> </p> <p><span class="notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">#LI-JH1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. forecast inputs, resolve data issues and improve the quality of financial information.</li> <li>Maintaining financial models, reporting templates and process documentation to improve consistency, governance and operational efficiency.</li> <li>Supporting investment business cases by gathering financial information, validating assumptions and preparing analysis for decision making.</li> supporting testing, implementation and continuous improvement projects.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong analytical skills with the ability to large datasets and using data to solve business problems.</li> <li>Strong organisation and planning skills, delivering work to agreed deadlines.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication skills, solving capability with the ability to use data and insight to identify root causes, evaluate options and implement practical, value adding solutions.</li> <li>Continuous improvement mindset with a passion for challenging the status quo, embedding best practice and creating a culture of operational excellence and learning.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £45,500 -
